topQueriesAllPhases.query:
WITH links AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT l.*,b.name AS block_name,s.key AS signature_key,s.expiration_date,s.token
 FROM territory_block l JOIN block b ON b.id=l.block_id LEFT JOIN signature s ON s.id=l.signature_id
 WHERE l.tenant_id=$1 AND l.territory_id=$2 AND l.block_id=$3 AND l.registration_status<>$6
), mappings AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT m.*,a.name,a.zip_code FROM territory_block_address m JOIN address a ON a.id=m.address_id
 JOIN links l ON l.id=m.territory_block_id WHERE m.registration_status<>$7
), requests AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT id,entity,action,target_id FROM change_request
 WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND territory_id=$2 AND block_id=$3 AND status=$8
), houses AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT h.*,a.name AS address_name,r.id AS round_id,r.completed,r.completed_date,r.end_date,r.leave_letter
 FROM house h JOIN links l ON l.block_id=h.block_id JOIN address a ON a.id=h.address_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id,completed,completed_date,end_date,leave_letter FROM round
   WHERE house_id=h.id AND round_number=$4 ORDER BY id LIMIT $9) r ON $10
 WHERE h.tenant_id=$1 AND h.territory_id=$2 AND h.registration_status<>$11 AND h.number<>$12
 AND (h.territory_block_address_id IS NULL OR h.territory_block_address_id IN(SELECT id FROM mappings))
), streets AS (
 SELECT address_id AS id,id AS mapping_id,name,zip_code,registration_status::text AS registration_status FROM mappings
 UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT h.address_id,$13::integer,h.address_name,$14::text,$15 FROM houses h
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT $16 FROM mappings m WHERE m.address_id=h.address_id)
), totals AS (
 SELECT count(*)::int AS catalog,count(*) FILTER(WHERE round_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS total,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE round_id IS NOT NULL AND completed)::int AS completed,
 max(completed_date) FILTER(WHERE round_id IS NOT NULL) AS last_worked FROM houses
)
SELECT json_build_object(
 $17,(SELECT json_build_object($18,id,$19,name,$20,image_url) FROM territory WHERE id=$2 AND tenant_id=$1),
 $21,(SELECT json_build_object($22,name,$23,city,$24,state,$25,phone) FROM multi_tenancy WHERE id=$1),
 $26,(SELECT json_build_object($27,l.block_id,$28,l.block_name,$29,l.registration_status,
   $30,(SELECT json_build_object($31,id,$32,action) FROM requests WHERE entity=$33 AND target_id=l.block_id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $34),
   $35,t.total,$36,t.catalog,$37,t.catalog-t.total,$38,t.completed,$39,t.total-t.completed,
   $40,to_char(t.last_worked, $41),$42,CASE WHEN l.signature_key IS NULL THEN $43 ELSE json_build_object($44,l.signature_key,$45,to_char(l.expiration_date, $46),$47,l.token) END
 ) FROM links l CROSS JOIN totals t),
 $48,coalesce((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object($49,s.id,$50,s.mapping_id,$51,s.name,$52,s.zip_code,$53,s.registration_status,
   $54,g.completed,$55,g.total-g.completed,$56,g.total,$57,g.catalog,$58,g.catalog-g.total,
   $59,(SELECT json_build_object($60,id,$61,action) FROM requests WHERE entity=$62 AND target_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.mapping_id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $63),
   $64,g.houses
 )) FROM streets s CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(*)::int AS catalog,count(*) FILTER(WHERE round_id IS NOT NULL)::int AS total,
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE round_id IS NOT NULL AND completed)::int AS completed,
   coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object($65,h.id,$66,h.number,$67,h.legend,$68,h.dont_visit,$69,h.complement,
     $70,h.registration_status,$71,(SELECT json_build_object($72,id,$73,action) FROM requests WHERE entity=$74 AND target_id=h.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $75),
     $76,$77,$78,h.round_id IS NOT NULL,$79,CASE WHEN h.round_id IS NOT NULL THEN h.completed ELSE $80 END,
     $81,CASE WHEN h.round_id IS NOT NULL THEN h.leave_letter ELSE $82 END,
     $83,h.round_id IS NULL OR h.end_date IS NOT NULL OR $5,
     $84,h."order",$85,to_char(h.completed_date, $86),$87,to_char(h.end_date, $88)
   )), $89::json) AS houses FROM houses h WHERE h.address_id=s.id
 ) g), $90::json),
 $91,EXISTS(SELECT $92 FROM requests GROUP BY entity,target_id HAVING count(*)>$93)
) AS payload

SELECT "t"."can_edit_structure" AS "canEditStructure","t"."id" AS "id","t"."key" AS "key","t"."expiration_date" AS "expirationDate","t"."token" AS "token","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId" FROM "signature" AS "t" WHERE "t"."key"=$1 AND "t"."tenant_id"=$2 AND "t"."expiration_date">$3 LIMIT $4

SELECT "t"."registration_status" AS "registrationStatus","t"."id" AS "id","t"."block_id" AS "blockId","t"."territory_id" AS "territoryId","t"."signature_id" AS "signatureId","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId" FROM "territory_block" AS "t" WHERE "t"."tenant_id"=$1 AND "t"."territory_id"=$2 AND "t"."block_id"=$3 AND "t"."registration_status" <> $4 LIMIT $5

WITH active AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT fs.client_id,fs.block_id,fs.address_id FROM field_session fs JOIN signature s ON s.key=fs.signature_key AND s.tenant_id=fs.tenant_id WHERE fs.tenant_id=$1 AND fs.territory_id=$2 AND fs.round_number=$3 AND fs.last_seen_at>now()-interval $5 AND fs.disconnected_at IS NULL AND s.expiration_date>now() AND ($4::integer IS NULL OR fs.block_id=$4)), b AS (SELECT block_id,count(DISTINCT client_id)::int AS n FROM active WHERE block_id IS NOT NULL AND block_id<>$6 GROUP BY block_id), a AS (SELECT block_id,address_id,count(DISTINCT client_id)::int AS n FROM active WHERE address_id IS NOT NULL AND address_id<>$7 GROUP BY block_id,address_id) SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT client_id)::int FROM active) AS total, coalesce((SELECT json_object_agg(block_id,n) FROM b),$8::json) AS blocks,coalesce((SELECT json_object_agg(coalesce(block_id::text,$9)||$10||address_id::text,n) FROM a),$11::json) AS streets

SELECT "t"."id" AS "id","t"."name" AS "name","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId","t"."type_id" AS "typeId","t"."image_url" AS "imageUrl" FROM "territory" AS "t" WHERE "t"."id"=$1 AND "t"."tenant_id"=$2 LIMIT $3

INSERT INTO field_session(tenant_id,territory_id,round_number,block_id,address_id,client_id,tab_id,signature_key) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,client_id,tab_id) WHERE disconnected_at IS NULL DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at=now()
SELECT round_number,revision FROM field_revision WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND territory_id=$2 AND block_id=$3 AND round_number IN ($5,$4)

SELECT "t"."status" AS "status","t"."type_ids" AS "typeIds","t"."started_at" AS "startedAt","t"."closed_at" AS "closedAt","t"."id" AS "id","t"."round_number" AS "roundNumber","t"."name" AS "name","t"."theme" AS "theme","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId","t"."color_primary" AS "colorPrimary","t"."color_secondary" AS "colorSecondary","t"."type" AS "type" FROM "round_info" AS "t" WHERE "t"."tenant_id"=$1 AND "t"."round_number"=$2 LIMIT $3

SELECT json_build_object($1,count(*) FILTER(WHERE state=$2),$3,count(*) FILTER(WHERE state=$4),$5,count(*),$6,count(*) FILTER(WHERE wait_event_type=$7),$8,(SELECT count(DISTINCT client_id) FROM field_session WHERE disconnected_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at>now()-interval $9 AND client_id~$10),$11,(SELECT count(DISTINCT tenant_id) FROM field_session WHERE disconnected_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at>now()-interval $12 AND client_id~$13)) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database()

UPDATE field_session SET disconnected_at=LEAST(now(),last_seen_at+interval $8) WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND client_id=$2 AND tab_id=$3 AND disconnected_at IS NULL AND (last_seen_at<=now()-interval $9 OR signature_key<>$4 OR block_id IS DISTINCT FROM $5::integer OR address_id IS DISTINCT FROM $6::integer OR round_number<>$7)
SELECT "t"."id" AS "id","t"."name" AS "name","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId" FROM "type" AS "t" WHERE ($2 AND "t"."id" IN ($1))

UPDATE round SET 
        update_date = $1, 
        completed = $2, 
        completed_date = $3 
      WHERE house_id = $4 AND round_number = $5

SELECT "t"."id" AS "id","t"."key" AS "key","t"."value" AS "value","t"."description" AS "description","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId" FROM "parameter" AS "t" WHERE "t"."tenant_id"=$1 AND "t"."key"=$2 LIMIT $3

SELECT json_build_object($1,coalesce(sum(calls),$2),$3,coalesce(sum(total_exec_time),$4)) FROM pg_stat_statements
